about.title: ASM NextGen Technical Campus
about.description: Empowering students with knowledge, innovation, technology, and industry-ready skills for a successful future.
about.whoIntro: Building the next generation of skilled professionals.
storyParagraphs: ASM NextGen Technical Campus is dedicated to providing quality education and creating an environment where students can learn, innovate, and grow.
The campus focuses on developing strong academic foundations along with practical knowledge, technical skills, and professional confidence.
Through modern learning approaches and industry exposure, students are encouraged to transform their ideas into meaningful solutions.
about.visionDescription: To nurture skilled, confident, and responsible professionals who are ready to contribute to a rapidly changing technological world.
about.whyIntro: An environment designed for learning, growth, and innovation.

admission.title: Build Your Future with ASM
admission.description: Explore Engineering and Computer Applications programmes and take the next step towards your academic and professional goals at ASM's NextGen Technical Campus.
admission.introDescription: Develop your technical knowledge, practical skills and problem-solving abilities in a learning environment focused on academic growth, innovation and career development. Explore the programmes below to find the right path for your goals.

programs.title: Engineering
programs.description: Build a foundation in engineering, technology and practical problem-solving through laboratory work and project-based learning.

programs.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
programs.description: Strengthen your knowledge of computer applications, software development and modern computing technologies.

admission.eligibilityIntro: Applicants should verify the current eligibility, entrance examination and admission requirements for their chosen programme.

eligibility.title: Engineering Qualification
eligibility.description: Applicants generally need to meet the prescribed educational qualifications, subjects and minimum marks for the selected undergraduate engineering programme.

eligibility.title: Engineering Entrance
eligibility.description: Applicants must meet the applicable entrance examination and merit requirements, as specified by the current admission rules.

eligibility.title: MCA Graduation Requirement
eligibility.description: Applicants need a recognised bachelor's degree and must satisfy the current subject and eligibility requirements for MCA admission.

eligibility.title: MCA Entrance Requirements
eligibility.description: Applicants must fulfil the applicable entrance examination, merit and counselling requirements prescribed for the admission year.

admission.importantNote: Eligibility rules may vary by programme and admission year. Confirm the latest official requirements before applying.

steps.title: Application
steps.description: Review the programme requirements and complete the applicable admission application.

steps.title: Document Verification
steps.description: Prepare and submit the required academic and supporting documents for verification.

steps.title: Admission Confirmation
steps.description: Complete the prescribed counselling, fee payment and admission formalities.

admission.ctaDescription: Contact the college to confirm current programme availability, eligibility and admission procedures.
